meta.description:
__TITLE__

Presents the question's rows as selectable cards and records the order in which the respondent touched them.

Required: paste the capture block from this package's demo into your survey, on the same page as the question and after it. The question checks the block at startup and refuses to run if it is missing, undersized or unwritable.

See IMPORT.md in this package for the ordered copy list and the settings reference. You do not need to open any other file.
